text_block_list.text:
We went on a long drive today.
To make sure we'd be back well before curfew, we decided to take the highway back—
Along the way, we decided to pull over at a service area for a break.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Highway service areas at night really have a great vibe, don't they!
...Hey, mind if I take a quick look around?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here,
I want to enjoy this place to the absolute fullest!"
choice_data_list: Ah, take care on your way.

text_block_list.text: After seeing Epiphaneia off, I take a sip of my drink and look around—

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Time to take a breather—
Phew~, this coffee is really hitting the spot~~~...

text_block_list.name: Office Worker Heading Home
text_block_list.text: Aah...! It's finally over! This project... was a total successss~~!!
choice_data_list: (I see, this is a "crossroad of fate" too.)

text_block_list.text:
"What came to mind was a scene from the past.
'Places exist to bring destinies together.'
That was the day I realized that."

Right here in this very place,
so many destinies are truly 'crossing.'
Feeling somehow glad as I strolled along—
—Suddenly, a beautiful singing voice reached my ears.

"Just as I thought," I mused, stopping in my tracks.
The familiar voice belonged to Epiphaneia.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...You came up here too, Trainer?
I had no idea this rest stop had such a high vantage point."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This is a great spot, isn't it?
You can clearly see everyone's destinies intersecting.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ah, look—over there.

text_block_list.name: Office Worker Heading Home
text_block_list.text:
I get to soak in a hot bath today, whoo-hoo!
Eat a feast, drink some booze—whoa, what!?

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Watch it, pal...!
Look where you're going!

text_block_list.name: Office Worker Heading Home
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry...! —Wait, ah!
What a gorgeous person...!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah!?
What're you blushing for, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Right at this moment, our destinies have crossed!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...How wonderful. To see so many
destinies intersecting and resonating
right before my eyes."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I could watch this forever,
just like this, while singing a song or something.

Her profile as she watches over the fates of the people. A gentle lullaby.
How to put it... She looks just like—
"As long as it's an 'intersection,' this place is surely just a passing point. For the people below—and for ourselves as well."

Eventually the stars will hide behind the clouds, and her lullaby will surely cease before long.
However... no, precisely because of that—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—...Haha.
What's with that lonely look on your face?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Come over next to me!
Where my voice can reach you even better!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to make that face.
Because we're right here, right now, for real!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Our destinies crossed at the academy that day—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps our paths might never have crossed.
Perhaps we might have unraveled.
Even so, the two of us made it all the way here—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Quietly watching over someone's fate like this.
Then, this must surely be—"

Tinged with a touch of melancholy,
yet undeniably warm, this was—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I think so too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Watching over everyone's destiny—
I am here, just the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy that this is my destiny!
choice_data_list: I'll never forget the fate that today holds.
I'll never forget the fate that today holds.
Shall we grab some ice cream on the way home after this?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy that this is my destiny!
choice_data_list: I'll never forget the fate that today holds.
I'll never forget the fate that today holds.
Shall we grab some ice cream on the way home after this?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right!
I'll remember it too—along with this song.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sing along with me. And let us watch over together—
the many destinies
illuminated by starlight!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Really!?
Whoa~ That's so awesome!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let's go buy some ice cream right now!
Come on, Trainer, now's the time, right this second!!

In stark contrast to a moment ago, she looked every bit her actual age.
Yet seeing both sides of her felt unmistakably true to who she was.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, very much so. To the point where
the rustling of the leaves sounds loud—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's so quiet—
...Now I'm getting all fidgety~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's run back to the car!
Let's go, Trainer!

Her loud voice was completely out of place on such a quiet night.
Seeing her utterly disregard the time and place brought an unintended chuckle out of me.
